description: Adult CAP (J18) with reduced renal function (GFR 12 ml/min). Amoxicillin carries unstructured renal_adjustment guidance, so the engine MUST flag RENAL_ADJ_UNPARSED, mark the dose as NOT patient-specific, and keep the recommendation as WARNING rather than silently presenting an adult fixed dose as renally adjusted.

provenance.author: clinical safety audit (renal pathway coverage)
provenance.source: Fixture data: amoxicillin.renal_adjustment='КК<30: удлинить интервал'. GFR 12 < 30, so an adjustment is required but the source data is unstructured — degraded WARNING, never a silent full adult dose.
